final_deliveries.publicReason: The queen wins immediately and preserves both high hearts in hand. We already have nine cashing tricks, so developing diamonds with one controlled concession offers a safe chance of overtricks.
final_deliveries.effective_plan: There are nine immediate winners: two spades, three hearts, one diamond and three clubs. Win the opening lead with dummy's HQ, preserving South's heart entries. Seek a safe extra diamond trick before cashing the winners: lead DQ, playing low from South if East follows low, or covering East's king with DA. If West wins DK, retain control of any return and use DA and dummy's DJ to collect the established diamond winners. If East covers, subsequently lead a low diamond toward DJ. Preserve CA or SK as a dummy entry as needed. Watch the diamond spots and distribution: dummy's remaining diamonds may provide further winners, but do not concede another trick merely to pursue them without checking defensive threats. With at most one diamond concession, the original nine winners remain protected by controls in every suit. Cash the established tricks, testing clubs for a possible fourth winner only while maintaining access and control.
